plugins.name: avista-memory-tools
plugins.description: Maintenance tools for the agent-instructions and memory layers — bootstrap a project CLAUDE.md from its source, audit existing CLAUDE.md files for content that belongs elsewhere, lint the auto-memory store for staleness and drift, and ship updates to Avista skill-bundle plugins through the org marketplace.

plugins.name: avista-wp-releases
plugins.description: Avista's WordPress release pipeline for plugins and themes — scaffold GitHub Releases + plugin-update-checker (PUC v5p6) auto-updates, and ship new versions through that pipeline.

plugins.name: avista-wp-prod-ops
plugins.description: Operate safely on Avista WordPress sites whose code lives on production and is reached over SSH — inspect-first triage, mandatory git backup of DB-stored code, and WP Code Box 2 snippet install/update without the admin UI.

plugins.name: avista-wpgb-trp-fix
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix the recurring bug where WP Grid Builder facets and pagination return the default language on TranslatePress sites — ships a transport-aware filter pair (query-var AJAX + REST insurance) that translates WPGB responses for the referer's language.
